subject: Headcount shift & temporary req hold
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Headcount shift & temporary req hold

Hi Laura / Evelyn —

I want to flag a short-term change I think we should make to open hiring while Q1 budget variance settles. Concretely: pause offers and new postings for a subset of product-facing roles (two PMs, one frontend) and temporarily reallocate one of those heads to Platform/Infra (REQ-2345). The intent is cost-neutral for the org headcount but to prioritize reliability/cost-efficiency work we need this sprint.

Attached is a snapshot of open reqs and the team-level ask (current-open-reqs.xlsx). Please advise what approvals you need to put a soft hold on active offers and live postings. If there are any pending offers at the final stage that need to go out today, note them here so we can handle exceptions.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Headcount shift & temporary req hold

Thanks Marissa — looped in Evelyn and Vivek as approvers for any change that affects posted offers. Quick questions:
- How many active offer letters are in flight for the roles you want to pause?
- Do you have suggested compensation bands for the infra role reallocation? (we'll need comp-bands-2026.pdf for equity checks)

I attached the current compensation bands and our consent checklist. If we are pausing postings we will: 1) stop new intake from TalentEdge and internal job posts, 2) instruct recruiters to put candidates on hold, 3) freeze new req creations until approvals land. If there are exceptions (strategic hires), please flag those now.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 11:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Headcount shift & temporary req hold

I support a temporary hold on non-critical postings provided two things: 1) we document the cost-neutral headcount reallocation and 2) any customer-facing hires with committed timelines get exception review.

Marissa — can you confirm the list of req IDs and candidate-stage statuses? We need a quick impact summary to present to finance if there is any shift to budget phasing. If security or infra-facing roles are urgent, prioritize those.

Vivek
VP, Engineering Operations
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Headcount shift & temporary req hold

Thanks — see proposed mapping attached (proposed-realloc.xlsx). High level: pause posting and offers for
- REQ-2401 PM, candidate pipeline stage: onsite
- REQ-2413 Frontend Eng, candidate pipeline stage: offer pending (TalentEdge)
- REQ-2420 PM, pipeline stage: screening

Move one head to REQ-2345 (Platform/Infra) to accelerate telemetry and KV cache work. Candidate exceptions: REQ-2413 is customer-facing (Acme AI PoC) — Nikhil, looping you for visibility. We can let that single offer proceed if you confirm the risk.

If we approve, Laura: please pause postings and instruct TalentEdge to put candidates on hold except for REQ-2413 if Nikhil signs off. I'll prepare a short note for Finance showing the reallocation as headcount-neutral.

—Marissa
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Headcount shift & temporary req hold

Marissa — REQ-2413 (Frontend / Acme AI) is on the critical path for the PoC kickoff next month. Offer has been verbally accepted; TalentEdge is preparing the paperwork. If we pause this one we risk delaying go-live and the first paid pilot. I recommend we allow 2413 to proceed and pause the other two.

If we let 2413 proceed, Laura, please prioritize closing the offer and confirm a signing window. For the paused reqs, happy to host a quick call with product to understand how soon the work can be postponed.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, TalentEdge Recruiting <recruiter@talentedge.co>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Headcount shift & temporary req hold

Putting final decisions in writing:
- Pause postings and new offers for REQ-2401 and REQ-2420 effective immediately. Recruiters: please move active candidates to HOLD.
- Allow REQ-2413 (Frontend / Acme AI) to proceed to offer — Laura, please prioritize paperwork and confirm start date by EOD Friday.
- Approve moving one head from REQ-2401 pool to REQ-2345 (Platform/Infra). Marissa will publish a short note to Finance showing the headcount-neutral reallocation (link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aB_realloc_proposal).

Action items:
- Laura: update Workday status for REQ-2401/2420 to Hold and confirm attachment of comp-bands-2026.pdf to the reqs.
- TalentEdge (Gina): freeze outreach on paused reqs; expedite offer packet for REQ-2413 to Aaron Lee.
- Nikhil: confirm candidate Aaron Lee will sign and share a candidate secure email for DocuSign.

Thanks all — we should revisit at the end of the month based on revenue variance.

Marissa Cole
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference
